messages:
sara_pm: follow-up from today's pm: consolidated action items from the fallback-loop postmortem. need owners + jira + RACI + due. reply like: owner / JIRA / RACI (R/A/C/I) / due (YYYY-MM-DD)

sara_pm: items:
1) selector race fix (race between selector + cold cache)
2) canary job to warm KV cache before rollout
3) playbook step: emergency pin + scale up for fallback spikes
4) billing alert & throttle prototype for fallback cost spikes
5) CI smoke perf test after deploy

tom_oncall: i'll take 3. tom_oncall / JIRA: RI-2801 / R=tom_oncall A=eng-sre C=oncall I=product / due: 2026-07-05

maya_platform: i'll own 2. maya_platform / JIRA: RI-2802 / R=maya_platform A=platform-lead C=raj_infra I=eng-all / due: 2026-07-12

nina_finance: i'll pair with maya on 4 (billing alert) but primary on finance side. nina_finance / JIRA: RI-2803 / R=nina_finance A=finance C=liz_runtime I=product / due: 2026-07-08

sara_pm: i'll pick 1 and coordinate acceptance criteria. sara_pm / JIRA: RI-2804 / R=sara_pm A=eng-pm C=maya_platform, tom_oncall I=eng-all / due: 2026-07-02

maya_platform: for 2: plan is a lightweight canary that replays recent traffic samples to warm caches. cost est ~2 GPU-hours/run. starting biweekly. will add checklist in RI-2802.

tom_oncall: for 3: adding a playbook snippet to RI-2801 that includes pin variant + autoscale steps + communication template for oncall.

nina_finance: for 4: prototype will emit a billing anomaly signal and temporary throttle flag. will coordinate with ops to test in staging before prod toggle.

sara_pm: 5) CI smoke - who wants? if no volunteers i'll assign to runtime team next rotation.

maya_platform: i'll add a note to RI-2802 to hand off to runtime for CI integration if platform prototype is stable.

ops-bot: Reminder created: "PM action items sync" recurring weekly starting 2026-06-15 16:00 UTC. Notified: sara_pm, tom_oncall, maya_platform, nina_finance.

sara_pm: recap: RI-2804(1)=sara_pm, RI-2802(2)=maya_platform, RI-2801(3)=tom_oncall, RI-2803(4)=nina_finance. 5=unassigned. add acceptance criteria in jira and tag me when ready. closing thread for now.
